record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.original_question: Let (X, X, μ, T1, ..., Tℓ) be a probability-measure-preserving system with commuting transformations, and let f0, f1, ..., fℓ be bounded measurable functions. Define the multiple correlation sequence C: Z^ℓ → C by C(n1, ..., nℓ) = ∫ f0 · T1^n1 f1 · ... · Tℓ^nℓ fℓ dμ. Is every such sequence an exact or approximate integral combination of generalized ℓ-step nilsequences in ℓ variables?

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Determine the structure of the multiple correlation sequences (C(n1, . . . , n`)) defined by (14). Is it true that any such sequence is an (approximate) integral combination of generalized `-step nilsequences in `-variables?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu, T_1,\dots,T_\ell)$ be a probability-measure-preserving system, where $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$ is a probability space and $T_1,\dots,T_\ell:X\to X$ are commuting invertible measure-preserving transformations. For bounded measurable functions $f_0,f_1,\dots,f_\ell:X\to\mathbb{C}$, define the multiple correlation sequence $C:\mathbb{Z}^\ell\to\mathbb{C}$ by
$$C(n_1,\dots,n_\ell)=\int_X f_0\cdot (T_1^{n_1}f_1)\cdots(T_\ell^{n_\ell}f_\ell)\,d\mu.$$
A function $\psi:\mathbb{Z}^\ell\to\mathbb{C}$ is called an $\ell$-step nilsequence in $\ell$ variables if there exist an $\ell$-step nilmanifold $G/\Gamma$ (with $G$ a connected, simply connected nilpotent Lie group of nilpotency class at most $\ell$ and $\Gamma$ a cocompact discrete subgroup), commuting elements $b_1,\dots,b_\ell\in G$, a continuous function $F:G/\Gamma\to\mathbb{C}$, and a point $x\in G/\Gamma$ such that $\psi(n_1,\dots,n_\ell)=F(b_1^{n_1}\cdots b_\ell^{n_\ell}\cdot x)$; "generalized" nilsequences allow $F$ to be merely bounded and Riemann integrable (or a suitable limit of such). A sequence $\phi:\mathbb{Z}^\ell\to\mathbb{C}$ is a null-sequence if $\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{1}{N^\ell}\sum_{n\in[1,N]^\ell}|\phi(n)|^2=0$.

Determine whether every multiple correlation sequence $C(n_1,\dots,n_\ell)$ of the above form can be written as an integral combination of generalized $\ell$-step nilsequences in $\ell$ variables, either exactly or up to an error that is small in uniform density (equivalently, whether $C$ decomposes as a sum of a generalized $\ell$-step nilsequence in $\ell$ variables and a null-sequence on $\mathbb{Z}^\ell$).
artifact.status_search_result: For a single transformation ($\ell$-variable correlations from one map with polynomial iterates), Frantzikinakis (Invent. Math. 2015) proved the decomposition as nilsequence plus uniform-density-small error. For commuting transformations, partial results exist (e.g., along primes by Koutsogiannis–Le–Moreira–Pavlov, and joint-ergodicity work of Frantzikinakis–Kuca). A 2025 preprint announces a proof that every multi-correlation sequence is the sum of a generalized nilsequence and a null-sequence, settling a conjecture of Frantzikinakis; pending peer review, the problem appears to be (at least nearly) resolved in the decomposition form.

status_evidence.title: Multiple correlation sequences and nilsequences (Frantzikinakis)
status_evidence.snippet: For polynomial iterates of a single transformation, the correlation sequence is a sum of a nilsequence and an error term small in uniform density.

status_evidence.title: A decomposition of multicorrelation sequences for commuting transformations along primes
status_evidence.snippet: Decomposition for commuting transformations along primes.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress for the commuting case along primes.

status_evidence.title: Structured extensions and multi-correlation sequences
status_evidence.snippet: We show that every multi-correlation sequence is the sum of a generalized nilsequence and a null-sequence. This proves a conjecture of N. Frantzikinakis.
status_evidence.claim: Recent preprint announcing a resolution of the decomposition conjecture.
